text: An Nulaaɗo, maakan yimɓe ɓen : "Ko mi addani on ko e ndee Alqur'aanaare, ko ɓural Alla e doww mooɗon, e yurmeende Makko. Ko ngal ɓural Alla ɗon e yurmeende Makko jippiniragol on ndee Alqur'aanaare, woni mantorton, wanaa goɗɗum goo. Ko Muhammadu (jom kisiyee) on addani ɓe immorde ka Joomi makko ɓuri moƴƴude e ko ɓe mooɓata e piiji aduna lannooji".
